## Summary
现任深圳安嘉科技有限公司软件研发部总监（2026.04 — 至今）。熟练使用 AI 工具，熟悉企业 FSD 设计与 AI Skill / MCP。主导 SightSys（https://www.sightsyscloud.com/）：App 架构重构，后台由 Python 迁至 Go，3 个月从零搭建云智控后台，并用 AI 智能体搭建企业 ERP；安防摄像机已上架 Alexa 与 Google Home。此前 Flutter 跨端与 IoT / 电商全链路可独立交付。

Director of Software R&D at Shenzhen Anjia Technology Co., Ltd. since Apr 2026. Proficient with AI tools, enterprise FSD (Feature-Sliced Design), and AI skills / MCP. Leads SightSys (https://www.sightsyscloud.com/): app architecture refactor, backend moved from Python to Go, cloud control console built from scratch in 3 months, and an enterprise ERP built with AI agents. Security cameras listed on Alexa and Google Home. Earlier Flutter, IoT, and e-commerce delivery remains on the resume.

- AI note, as stated: 使用 Cursor、v0、Claude code 等 AI 工具大幅提升 Flutter 开发与设计效率。 Used Cursor, v0, Claude code, and other AI tools to raise Flutter development and design efficiency.
